audit.whatIsWrong: Chart hands Levels 3, 4-5, First item and 2+ items to Warwick and rates the lane TRICKY 7/10, while the prose on those exact rows says this is your punish window, you out-poke him, you out-damage his sustain, and 'He has no scaling to reclaim the lane.'
audit.why: Packet chart is Neeko on rows 1-6; win rate 100% over 14 games; content 'late' opens 'You stay ahead here, which is rare for you'. Nothing in either kit supports a Warwick-favoured mid or late row against an 800/1000-range poke kit.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 to Neeko as one atomic pair-matched group, and the difficulty enums moved to FAVOURED 4/10 with carry threat 5/10 to match.

audit.why: Four spikes: Lvl 3 Q+E, Lvl 6 Pop Blossom, 1st item Liandry's/Blackfire, and his Lvl 6+ Infinite Duress window. The R timing is right — 110/90/70s means his kill window is a scheduled event, not a constant threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: content 'early' states Warwick has 'no dash', and whys[1] says he has 'no way to close the gap'. Both are false.
audit.why: Riot: Q Jaws of the Beast — 'Warwick lunges forward and bites his target' — a 365-range dash on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, and it also deals damage based on the target's maximum health and heals him for it. Infinite Duress is a second leap. Telling a player he cannot close is the mistake that gets them bitten at level 2.
audit.corrected: Name Jaws of the Beast as the 365-range lunge and build the spacing rule around it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining ability has no cooldown attached anywhere.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s and suppresses for 1.5 seconds; Primal Howl is 15s at rank 1 and fears for 1 second after 2.5 seconds of damage reduction. The 110s R downtime at rank 1 is the single most punishable window in the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears once in report[8]; the content layer describes out-damaging his sustain without ever naming Grievous Wounds, and never mentions the low-health healing scaling that decides whether he dies.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger heals him for his bonus magic damage below 50% health and triples it below 25%; Q and R both heal as well. Poke that would kill anyone else gets refunded exactly when you are trying to finish him.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds and the sub-25% tripling folded into spikes[2].text.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Warwick carry threat 7.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Warwick carry threat 5/10.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Warwick carry threat 7.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Warwick carry threat 5/10.

edits.before: Lock-on suppress — track it before every step-up. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: A 1.5s suppress on a 110s cooldown at rank 1 — until he spends it, every commit is a coin flip.

edits.before: Your second Q point gives you poke he has to Q-heal back, and he still has no way to close the gap without eating it.
edits.after: Your second Q point out-ranges Jaws of the Beast at 365 — he has to lunge into the poke and heal it back after.

edits.before: Liandry's / Blackfire Torch: your DoT and re-bloom out-damage his drain sustain and shred him through W move speed.
edits.after: Liandry's / Blackfire plus Grievous Wounds: his passive triples its healing below 25% HP, so anti-heal is what closes kills.

edits.before: Warwick is a melee drain bruiser with no dash and no skillshot to dodge your stuff, so this is your range game. At Level 1 you both have nothing, so just deny his Q last-hits and set the wave. The moment you have E (Tangle-Barbs) plus Q at Level 3, you get your first real window: root him from max distance so the duration scales up, then drop Blooming Burst so it re-blooms on a stationary target he can't out-heal. Don't throw E into nothing — if he reads it and walks in with W speed, you've handed him the trade.
edits.after: Warwick is a melee drain bruiser whose only gap-close is Jaws of the Beast (Q), a 365-range lunge, so this is your range game. At Level 1 you both have nothing, so just deny his Q last-hits and set the wave. The moment you have E (Tangle-Barbs) plus Q at Level 3, you get your first real window: root him from max distance so the duration scales up, then drop Blooming Burst so it re-blooms on a stationary target he can't out-heal. Don't throw E into nothing — if he reads it and lunges in with W speed, you've handed him the trade.

notes: Chart rows 1-6 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group (row 0 was already Neeko and row 4 was already Neeko, so only rows 1,2,3,5,6 change). The difficulty enum flip to FAVOURED is Medium confidence: it follows the packet chart, the 100%/14-game sample and the champion's own prose, but 14 games is a thin sample — if the user prefers to keep TRICKY, the chart rows should still be flipped, since the prose already contradicts them. Unverified and left alone: 'W invisibility' in 'mid' and wants.you[1]/[2] — Riot's W text gives a clone plus bonus damage and move speed, with no stealth flag; this claim recurs across the whole champion and should be settled once at champion level. whys[3] also says 'W-chase' where W (Blood Hunt) is the 4000-range sense/move-speed tool — accurate, no change needed.
